description: GoiEner and the University of Deusto publish three R scripts for converting original electricity-meter records into cleaned load profiles. The documented stages collect SIMEL entries by anonymised supply-point identifier, remove duplicate timestamps and create raw CSVs, then impute gaps and adjust local timestamps. Cleaning also excludes short and zero-valued profiles and handles the COVID-period split. The GitHub source code is free under GPL-3.0. Coverage follows the Spanish cooperative's supplied records or compatible new inputs, with no fixed run horizon in the software. It prepares the series represented by data-goiener-smart-meter-data-spain for demand simulations with model-pypsa. A caveat is that users must edit local paths and review filtering and imputation choices before drawing conclusions about unusual demand. The scripts were documented but not run, and no household-level data were obtained.
